place_fields.vibe: Historic hill fort and panoramic trek
place_fields.summary: Hutridurga is a fortified hill and historic site with stone fortifications, gateways, temples and broad views from the summit. The hill is one of the traditional Nava Durgas around Bengaluru.
place_fields.best_time: September to February is generally preferable for trekking; avoid slippery conditions after heavy rain and harsh midday summer heat.

planning_attributes.description: A historic hill fort near Huthridurga village in Kunigal taluk, with a summit temple and surviving fortification remains.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: About 4,000 ft above sea level; sources vary on the exact summit elevation.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The fort is traditionally attributed to Kempegowda in the 16th century and is described as a military bastion during the Tipu Sultan period before British capture in the late 18th century.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Huthridurga village by road from the Bengaluru/Kunigal side; the district tourism page identifies road access and Tumakuru as the nearest major railway connection.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: No reliable current official restriction schedule was established.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The summit trek is rocky and can be challenging; use appropriate footwear and take care on wet rock and exposed sections.

place_fields.summary: Ramadevara Betta near Tumakuru is a rocky trekking destination with broad views and nearby wildlife habitat. Published trek guidance describes challenging terrain and recommends cooler, drier months.
place_fields.best_time: September to February is recommended; peak monsoon can make trails slippery and muddy, while summer heat favors early starts.

planning_attributes.description: A hill near Tumakuru associated with trekking and wildlife habitat, with rocky terrain and views across the surrounding landscape.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: About 1,177 m is reported for the Ramadevara Betta peak; published figures vary by mapped summit.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Local tradition associates the hill with Rama and Sita during exile; this is a religious tradition rather than a verified historical event.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Published trek guidance describes access from the Booraga Marada Palya side, with Kyatsandra as the nearest public-transport access point.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Forest-area access may be regulated; verify current permit or entry requirements before visiting.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The route includes rocky and steep sections. Wildlife is reported in the area, so follow local forest guidance and avoid disturbing animals.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly; some web sources use different mapped coordinates for Ramadevara Betta, so identity should be checked against the supplied place record.
